why: The underground loop for minimal-ground (owner 2026-09-30: "the underground rave thing, lights like that, not the commercial shit"): darkness, haze, cold white and deep red only, the DJ a silhouette, the structure revealed in pieces, one blinder hit. Movers all on the ground, so it works the roof and the walls: beams up and across above head height, columns from below. The loop is the holds: 79 s; a cue's fade is inside its hold. No laser cue (a laser needs a certified laser safety officer). Designed and tested, NOT seen on a screen. Scenes: scripts/rigbuild/ground-scenes.mjs.
